relations.subject: Hla Pe
relations.evidence: After high school, he went to Rangoon University and earned an MA in Burmese in 1938.

relations.subject: Hla Pe
relations.object: Institute of Education, University of London
relations.evidence: In 1939, he got a Diploma in Education from the Institute of Education, University of London.

relations.subject: Hla Pe
relations.object: University of London's School of Oriental Studies
relations.evidence: In 1944 he obtained his doctorate in Burmese at the University of London's School of Oriental Studies (later renamed the School of Oriental and African Studies).

relations.subject: Hla Pe
relations.evidence: was Professor of Burmese at SOAS from 1966 until his retirement in 1980.
